## About
Carriere HVAC-Electric provides generator, air conditioning, electrical and heating sales, service and support to the Greater Katy-Houston area. We were originally located in the Boston area before coming to Katy.
We handle installation, maintenance and repair, from a new whole house Generac to routine maintenance or emergency repair service. Our pricing is straightforward: we tell you what needs to be done to get your system working again and exactly what it will cost.
Neighbors have given us a 4.8 rating from 145 Google reviews. Give us a call.

## Services
- Generac: Whole house Generac generators, installed and maintained by Mike and his team.
- A/C Service: Air conditioning installation, maintenance and repair for all major brands.
- Heating: Help deciding how to handle your heating service and replacement concerns.
- Service and Repair: Straightforward pricing and a clear explanation of what needs to be done and what it will cost.
- New Systems: High-efficiency central air installs, sized with a load calculation for your home.
- Hybrid Heating Systems: Heating set up to maximize energy savings.
- Oil to Gas Conversion: Converting an oil heating system to gas.
- Electrical: Electrical installation, maintenance and repair by our team.

## FAQ
Q: What does a service call cost?
A: Service starts with a $99 diagnosis fee. We then tell you what needs to be done and exactly what the cost will be.

Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes, we offer free estimates for installations and replacements.

Q: Will you work on my brand of equipment?
A: Yes. We work on all brands.

Q: How soon will I hear back if I send a message?
A: If needed, you will hear back within 48-72 hours. For anything sooner, give us a call.
